status: Partial Photoshop 2026 parity: Stripes implemented, bounded RGB8 exactness; Smooth and broader output remain open

sources.scope: Photoshop 2026 live UI and original saved output files
Existing continuous ramp conventions; Stripes is independently implemented from the new saved probes
Adobe interpolation terminology; this page documents Classic/Linear/Perceptual, not the newly observed Smooth/Stripes algorithms
Official enum documentation corroborates GIMs and Smoo record codes, not rendering algorithms

implemented: Native Stripes holds each color and opacity stop until the next stop; coincident positions use the last stop; midpoint and smoothness controls remain retained but inactive for Stripes.
Shared gradient method picker connects Stripes to live and Classic tools, Gradient Fill, Gradient Map, swatches and saved presets; GRD/GdFl/grdm encode GIMs.

RGB8/16 Gradient Map preview, editable layers, masks, presets, undo and native archive remain available; RGB32 map creation/editing and editable PSD export reject, retaining legacy native content for rendering and recovery.
Photoshop-saved zero-angle fill descriptors now import at zero instead of the New Fill UI default of 90 degrees.
Inactive integer noisePreSeed metadata is retained on undithered fill edits; active seeded dither rejects explicitly until represented.
An empty all-white generated vector-mask record with no real mask is accepted as identity. Nontrivial unsupported rasterized-vector parameters still reject.
Native full/regional rendering now exercises 120 depth/style/method/dither combinations; 60 native PSD depth/style/method fill round trips retain controls and native pixels.

evidence.smooth_probe: Three-stop Smooth outputs at smoothness 0 and 100 have identical stored merged channels. This does not yet identify or implement its transfer function.
evidence.rgb32: Photoshop warned of unsupported layer data and discarded the Gradient Map when Keep Layers was chosen; its Gradient Map menu was disabled in RGB32. No RGB32 Photoshop output qualifies as a reference.
